title: Audit telemetry sharding & compact blob archival policy
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem statement: Audit logging volume has grown ~4x year-over-year. Current monolithic time-indexed shards cause hot partitions, unpredictable query latency, and increased S3/Elasticsearch costs. We need a new ingestion + storage posture that reduces storage unit-cost, keeps fast search for compliance queries (sub-1s median for recent 30d), supports per-tenant retention SLAs, and allows legal-hold/override without inflating overall cost.

Scope: Design and implement a sharding+indexing policy for the audit ingestion pipeline and a compact blob archival lifecycle that together cut cold storage costs by at least 40% while maintaining compliance searchability for common operators. This ticket covers design, prototype, rollout plan, migration/backfill strategy, and instrumentation. Implementation will be incremental and feature-gated behind a rollout flag for 10% pilot tenants first.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved by Security and Compliance: shard key, compaction cadence, and legal-hold semantics
Prototype in staging demonstrates 30-50% storage reduction for 90d+ data via compaction + compression
Search latency for recent 30d audits: median < 1s, 95th < 3s for typical tenant queries in pilot
Per-tenant retention controls enforceable via console & API; legal-hold preserves events regardless of TTL
Automated TTL enforcer implemented with reconciliation job; test coverage for edge cases (clock skew, partial writes)
Cost controls: budget alerting for tenants and automatic downsampling policy for low-value streams
Migration plan with backfill noop for queries and rollback steps documented and runbook published
tasks: Write design doc: include shard strategy (time + tenant + event-class), index skeleton, and compaction format
Prototype ingestion router changes to write primary index + compacted blob variant to S3
Implement compaction pipeline: dedupe, columnar compression (Parquet/ORC), and per-blob index summary
Add metadata store entries: blob-manifest with tenant_id, shard_id, min_ts, max_ts, event_count, sample_hash
Build TTL enforcer service with legal-hold override and reconciliation metrics
Console API: UI controls for retention tiers and legal holds; integrate with RBAC v2 admin roles
Add sampling/downsample policy for high-volume low-value events (audit-quiet mode) and budget trigger
Create migration/backfill plan and run initial backfill on 5% historical data in staging
Instrument dashboards: storage delta by retention tier, query latency histograms, reconciliation errors
Security review and compliance signoff; update SOC2 audit checklist entries
